description: This file defines the ReadOnlyHelperDAO class, a data access object implementing read-only operations for entities within the Apache OFBiz framework. It provides methods for retrieving entity data without modifying the database, ensuring the helper operates in a non-destructive read-only mode.

classes.name: ReadOnlyHelperDAO
classes.description: A DAO class providing read-only access to entity data, implementing the GenericHelper interface. It disables create, update, and delete operations, allowing only data retrieval and metadata verification.

methods.name: getHelperName
methods.description: Returns the full name of the helper based on HelperInfo.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Attempt to create a new entity value, but operation is disabled, always returns null.

methods.name: createAll
methods.description: Attempt to create multiple entity values; operation is disabled, always returns null.

methods.name: findByPrimaryKey
methods.description: Retrieves an entity by primary key; constructs a GenericValue and populates it via DAO select.

methods.name: findByPrimaryKeyPartial
methods.description: Retrieves partial entity data for a given primary key based on selected fields.

methods.name: findAllByPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Fetches multiple entities by their primary keys, calling findByPrimaryKey for each.

methods.name: removeByPrimaryKey
methods.description: Operation disabled; always returns 0 indicating no deletion.

methods.name: findListIteratorByCondition
methods.description: Returns an iterator over entities matching specified conditions; defers to DAO method.

methods.name: findByMultiRelation
methods.description: Retrieves related entities through multiple relation mappings.

methods.name: findCountByCondition
methods.description: Returns a count of entities matching specified conditions.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Update operation is disabled; always returns 0.

methods.name: storeByCondition
methods.description: Update by condition is disabled; always returns 0.

methods.name: checkDataSource
methods.description: Verifies the data source schema; calls DAO to check database structure with addMissing set to false.
